home loop

Imagine this a an RSS feed, looping over articles…

This is a markdown file

The first issue is that components with private @-prefixed attributes aren't recognized as HTML…

<media-gallery :@from-data="this.gallery">

Removing the @ sign, the component is rendered -- but inside a paragraph! That's a markdown issue. It happens with all inline-default elements:

Oh no! There's no data to render!!!

this is <my-element> wrapped in a paragraph

it does the same with a <span> or other inline HTML

INSTEAD, we can wrap our webc in a <figure> to get the desired output. Markdown-it knows this is block-level HTML, and it's not wrapped:

This page has to be parsed as md and not webc,md -- because we need markdown to escape characters in a code-block before webc gets ahold of it:

<!-- this is a code block and should not render -->
<figure>
  <media-gallery :@from-data="this.gallery"></media-gallery>
</figure>

It all works great! Until we access this same page inside a loop, there's no gallery data anyway!

This works the same if we use @raw in the loop, and @html in the layout.
